name: 朝鲜
summary: 朝鲜外务省官方机构入口；本站尚未确认面向普通申请人的公开移民申请渠道，具体资格、文件、费用和办理时间亦未复核。
summaryEn: Official institutional entry point for North Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs; no public immigration application channel for ordinary applicants has been confirmed here, and eligibility, documents, fees, and timing have not been reviewed.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea
sources.title: Official ministry portal
